title: 'Meet me at the Mandarin': Mandarin Oriental returns to PH
summary: Filipinos will now hear again the phrase “Meet me at the Mandarin” as The Mandarin Oriental opens once again in the Philippines, Laurent Kleitman, its Group Chief Executive said.
